cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Drop the demand to question our delivery driver. The missing-parcel claim goes through this form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your form requires a photo of the parcel I haven't received.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Use a photo of your empty doorstep. That's the delivery location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand in it holding today's newspaper?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beside the doormat. Put me under 'supporting evidence,' and leave the driver off your witness list.

mechanism: A corrects its former claims pupil incomplete use of the official form, accepting a personal evidence role to persuade B to withdraw a driver-interrogation request.
confusable: Not dismissing the missing parcel or simply obstructing: A solves the form obstacle so B will abandon the extra challenge.
comparison: Official claim evidence negotiated personally versus queue privilege exchanged for visible recognition.
